messages.text: Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P2 10TH/s

Good news first: the P2 is $369 right now, down from $449. It pulls about 166 W, so at 12–20¢ you're looking at roughly $14 to $24 a month in power. Quiet too, around 40 dB.

Where will it be running — what state or country? I'll run your actual sats-per-month and break-even numbers for that address.
Handed to the team · Netherlands is the one EU country with no VAT line on the page; needs a definiti

At 166 W it's about 121 kWh a month, so $14.50 at 12¢ and $24 at 20¢. That's your real running cost.

Honest framing: 10 TH/s solo is sats-stacking plus a lottery ticket, not profit at today's price. If you want the best value per TH, the Magic Miner 40T at $799 is four times the hashrate. The P2 is the quiet, cheap-to-run way in.

Thor P2 ships October 3, 2026. One thing on the Dutch side: our NL page doesn't state a VAT line, so rather than guess I've pinged Georges — he'll jump into this chat with the exact answer, or email you if you step away.
